shared_elements: carved relief on a large upright stone slab
figure with head-covering / headdress and long garment
circular disc or rosette motif on the surface
figure holding or bearing an object at chest level
justification: Both depict a single frontal-or-profile anthropomorphic personage in relief on an upright slab, with a head-covering, a long body/garment and at least one circular disc motif on the torso area, which is a generic correspondence any monumental figural tradition could produce. A shows a bird-headed, multi-winged figure in strict profile holding a bucket and cone beside an elaborate stylised plant with rosettes and a band of dense linear script above, whereas B is a blocky, near-featureless columnar figure with folded arms, a belt-like band and a plain boss, with no wings, no bird head, no plant and no inscription band.
